home_note.name: home_note
home_note.default: '今天也辛苦啦，记得收下属于你的小快乐。'

notification_email_outbox_content_check.name: notification_email_outbox_content_check
notification_email_outbox_content_check.value:
length(trim("notification_email_outbox"."event_type")) > 0
        AND length(trim("notification_email_outbox"."event_key")) > 0
        AND length(trim("notification_email_outbox"."subject")) > 0
        AND length(trim("notification_email_outbox"."heading")) > 0
        AND length(trim("notification_email_outbox"."message")) > 0
        AND length(trim("notification_email_outbox"."action_label")) > 0
        AND "notification_email_outbox"."action_path" LIKE '/%'

draw_records_result_fields_check.name: draw_records_result_fields_check
draw_records_result_fields_check.value:
(
        ("draw_records"."result_type" = 'prize'
          AND "draw_records"."prize_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "draw_records"."pool_item_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "draw_records"."retry_option_id" IS NULL
          AND "draw_records"."extra_count" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("draw_records"."result_type" = 'retry'
          AND "draw_records"."prize_id" IS NULL
          AND "draw_records"."pool_item_id" IS NULL
          AND "draw_records"."retry_option_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "draw_records"."extra_count" > 0)
        OR
        ("draw_records"."result_type" = 'miss'
          AND "draw_records"."prize_id" IS NULL
          AND "draw_records"."pool_item_id" IS NULL
          AND "draw_records"."retry_option_id" IS NULL
          AND "draw_records"."extra_count" IS NULL)
      )

prize_stock_logs_source_check.name: prize_stock_logs_source_check
prize_stock_logs_source_check.value:
(
        ("prize_stock_logs"."reason" = 'draw'
          AND "prize_stock_logs"."delta" = -1
          AND "prize_stock_logs"."draw_record_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("prize_stock_logs"."reason" = 'admin_add'
          AND "prize_stock_logs"."delta" > 0
          AND "prize_stock_logs"."draw_record_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("prize_stock_logs"."reason" = 'admin_reduce'
          AND "prize_stock_logs"."delta" < 0
          AND "prize_stock_logs"."draw_record_id" IS NULL)
      )

prize_wins_source_check.name: prize_wins_source_check
prize_wins_source_check.value:
(
        ("prize_wins"."source" = 'draw' AND "prize_wins"."draw_record_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("prize_wins"."source" = 'admin_grant' AND "prize_wins"."draw_record_id" IS NULL)
      )

prize_wins_status_timestamps_check.name: prize_wins_status_timestamps_check
prize_wins_status_timestamps_check.value:
(
        ("prize_wins"."status" = 'unredeemed'
          AND "prize_wins"."requested_at" IS NULL
          AND "prize_wins"."redeemed_at" IS NULL
          AND "prize_wins"."revoked_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("prize_wins"."status" = 'requested'
          AND "prize_wins"."requested_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "prize_wins"."redeemed_at" IS NULL
          AND "prize_wins"."revoked_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("prize_wins"."status" = 'redeemed'
          AND "prize_wins"."requested_at" IS NULL
          AND "prize_wins"."redeemed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "prize_wins"."revoked_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("prize_wins"."status" = 'revoked'
          AND "prize_wins"."requested_at" IS NULL
          AND "prize_wins"."redeemed_at" IS NULL
          AND "prize_wins"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)
      )

ticket_balance_logs_source_check.name: ticket_balance_logs_source_check
ticket_balance_logs_source_check.value:
(
        ("ticket_balance_logs"."reason" = 'draw_cost'
          AND "ticket_balance_logs"."delta" = -1
          AND "ticket_balance_logs"."draw_record_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("ticket_balance_logs"."reason" = 'retry_reward'
          AND "ticket_balance_logs"."delta" > 0
          AND "ticket_balance_logs"."draw_record_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("ticket_balance_logs"."reason" = 'admin_grant'
          AND "ticket_balance_logs"."delta" > 0
          AND "ticket_balance_logs"."draw_record_id" IS NULL
          AND length(trim("ticket_balance_logs"."note")) > 0)
        OR
        ("ticket_balance_logs"."reason" = 'admin_revoke'
          AND "ticket_balance_logs"."delta" < 0
          AND "ticket_balance_logs"."draw_record_id" IS NULL)
      )

ticket_types_grant_window_check.name: ticket_types_grant_window_check
ticket_types_grant_window_check.value: "ticket_types"."grant_start_at" IS NULL OR "ticket_types"."grant_end_at" IS NULL OR "ticket_types"."grant_start_at" < "ticket_types"."grant_end_at"

quiz_answers_value_check.name: quiz_answers_value_check
quiz_answers_value_check.value:
(
        ("quiz_answers"."question_type_snapshot" = 'single'
          AND "quiz_answers"."selected_option_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND length(trim("quiz_answers"."selected_option_text_snapshot")) > 0
          AND "quiz_answers"."text_answer" IS NULL
          AND "quiz_answers"."is_correct" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("quiz_answers"."question_type_snapshot" = 'text'
          AND "quiz_answers"."selected_option_id" IS NULL
          AND "quiz_answers"."selected_option_text_snapshot" IS NULL
          AND length(trim("quiz_answers"."text_answer")) > 0
          AND "quiz_answers"."is_correct" IS NULL)
      )

quiz_attempts_reward_snapshot_check.name: quiz_attempts_reward_snapshot_check
quiz_attempts_reward_snapshot_check.value:
(
        ("quiz_attempts"."reward_balance_log_id" IS NULL AND "quiz_attempts"."reward_ticket_name_snapshot" IS NULL AND "quiz_attempts"."reward_quantity_snapshot" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("quiz_attempts"."reward_balance_log_id" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("quiz_attempts"."reward_ticket_name_snapshot")) > 0 AND "quiz_attempts"."reward_quantity_snapshot" > 0)
      )

quizzes_reward_check.name: quizzes_reward_check
quizzes_reward_check.value:
(
        ("quizzes"."reward_ticket_type_id" IS NULL AND "quizzes"."reward_quantity" = 0 AND "quizzes"."reward_note" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("quizzes"."reward_ticket_type_id" IS NOT NULL AND "quizzes"."reward_quantity" > 0 AND length(trim("quizzes"."reward_note")) > 0)
      )
